# Git & Python Foundations

**Learning archive · Git, GitHub, Python, and HTML**

An early practice repository for learning version control and working with small Python and HTML files in PyCharm. It is retained as part of the learning history, not presented as a research project or production application.

## Contents

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [main.py](../main.py) | Python practice |
| [index.html](../index.html) | Minimal HTML example |
| [example.txt](../example.txt) | Small text file used in repository practice |
| [Original README](../README.md) | Original project description |

The practice files and Git history are unchanged.
